The Tasmanian Government has helped fund it through grants.\n\n**Who runs it**\n- EHT is a private company set up in March 2017 by a group of EV enthusiasts. Its aim is a network of fast chargers covering all parts of Tasmania.\n- The first six sites were helped by a $200,000 grant from the Tasmanian Government's ChargeSmart program. A further $320,000 in 2021 funded 10 more sites, installed in 2022/23.\n- EHT uses Chargefox for billing and customer support.\n- One forum post says NRMA owns all of EHT's charging sites. This is a forum claim and I haven't verified it.\n- \"The Tasmanian electric vehicle fast charging network\" is the government's name for all the fast chargers it has supported. EHT operates only some of them (a forum poster's explanation).\n\n**Evie**\n- Evie Networks is a separate operator. It runs ultra-rapid 350 kW sites at Campbell Town, Brighton and Westbury. Evie and Chargefox funded the first two ultra-rapid stations, with ARENA support.\n- Evie's Kingston Town Shopping Centre site is 50 kW.\n\n**Prices**\n- EHT changed its pricing on 8 April 2024. 2026-11-18T11:09:19.5584694Z   **Added**
2026-11-18T11:09:19.5585298Z   - **WA EV Network:** typical $0.60 per kWh, covering Horizon Power's sites. The figure comes from Horizon Power's pricing page as search returned it, because the page itself refused my fetch.
2026-11-18T11:09:19.5586253Z   - **Exploren:** `siteReading` is `forbidden` and the price is null. I also matched "engie" to it, since search results agree Exploren took over Engie's DC network in 2025.

2026-11-18T11:09:19.5587324Z   
2026-11-18T11:09:19.5587494Z   **Folded into Chargefox**
2026-11-18T11:09:19.5587966Z   - **Yurika and Queensland Electric Super Highway:** Yurika's page and a search summary say you charge through the Chargefox app.
2026-11-18T11:09:19.5588497Z   - **RAA:** RAA's own page says you charge and pay in the Chargefox app.
2026-11-18T11:09:19.5589062Z   - **Electric Highway Tasmania:** search results say it uses Chargefox for billing. That one rests on search results, not a page I opened.
